cards.text: VEL-WEEKENDER-LIVEOUT-02 V5 — FLAP MECHANISM FIX

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: SHIPPED 2026-08-24. VEL-WEEKENDER-GS-LIVEOUT-02-v5.mp4, 1080x1920, 35.69s, -14.9 LUFS. Two beats in v4 did not show the Weekender's real opening mechanism. The 14.0s beat is now REAL filmed footage of the actual bag opening. The 20.2s beat is a regenerated and re-animated S7 with the flap in frame. VO, caption cards and all twelve other beats are byte-identical to v4.

Three tabs merged into one straight edge. No gold oval plate on the flap. The plate is on the BODY BAND instead, the exact inverse of the real bag. Interior reads cream canvas, not caramel leather.

Real footage of the actual bag. Opens on the closed flap with all three tabs and the gold oval keyhole plate, folds all the way back, ends on the caramel leather interior with the bag holding its shape. Nothing generated, so nothing to fail.

cards.title: REJECTED — kept for the audit trail  ·  8 keyframes generated across two passes, 6 rejected

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: WHAT FIXED THE FLAP
cards.text: Two changes at once, after this geometry had failed about a dozen times across three runs. One, the i2i anchor moved off the closed hero and onto the real open-bag photographs. Two, the flap-tab language moved to the very front of the prompt written as a left-to-right reading of the flap edge, with explicit counts. Pass 1 without counts gave four slots on one candidate. Pass 2 with counts gave correct counts on every roll.

cards.title: WHY THE FIRST BEAT WENT TO REAL FOOTAGE
cards.text: Every engine merges the three tabs into one slab sooner or later. Real footage of the actual bag opening removes the failure mode entirely and is the strongest proof available for that VO line.

cards.title: PROCESS
cards.text: H was animated first and then thrown away over two hardware defects. That is the 8/24 law working as intended: a missing, invented or malformed structural element is a FAIL, never a note. Passing those as notes is what put the two defects into v4 in the first place.
